title: Correct the positive-offset example in the operations guide

files.patch:
diff --git a/docs/operations/timezones.md b/docs/operations/timezones.md
--- a/docs/operations/timezones.md
+++ b/docs/operations/timezones.md
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 # Reading offset timestamps
 
-An offset of +02:00 is two hours behind UTC.
-For example, 09:00+02:00 corresponds to 11:00Z on the same date.
+An offset of +02:00 is two hours ahead of UTC.
+For example, 09:00+02:00 corresponds to 07:00Z on the same date.
 
 The examples use fixed offsets rather than named time zones.
